component.name: Hyper Linux
component.summary: Control Cloud III Wireless headsets on Linux

description.p: An independent desktop app for Cloud III Wireless headsets, with battery status, microphone mute, sidetone, automatic power-off and PipeWire audio effects.
This project was vibe-coded with AI assistance. It is experimental and is not affiliated with HyperX or HP.

screenshot.caption: Headset controls with an English interface

description.p: English interface and AppImage and Debian packages.
